  • Method Details

    • encode

      ExecutionFlow<CloseableByteBody> encode(Object element)
      Encode an element, with the bytes that precede it, e.g. the separator of a JSON array. Called one element at a time, in order.
      Parameters:
      element - The element
      Returns:
      The bytes of the element, possibly encoded on another thread, e.g. by a blocking writer

    • end

      @Nullable ReadBuffer end(boolean none)
      The bytes that end the body, e.g. the end of a JSON array.
      Parameters:
      none - Whether there was no element
      Returns:
      The bytes, or null if there are none
